title: Specification-Grounded Adaptive Triage and Formal Invariant Exclusion Synthesis for Autonomous Silicon Coverage Closure
abstract: arXiv:2611.26815v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Closing the final 5%-15% of code and functional coverage remains a major schedule bottleneck in silicon tapeouts. Existing LLM-based coverage closure loops feed raw uncovered RTL lines or branches directly into iterative prompts, failing on industrial subsystems due to: (1) token and context explosion from querying thousands of correlated holes independently; (2) illegal stimulus that violates cross-signal invariants and yields dirty coverage; and (3) unsafe exclusion hallucination on structurally unreachable dead code.   We present ARGUS (Autonomous Reachability & Guided Unified Stimulus), a specification-grounded, dual-regime coverage closure and formal exclusion synthesis engine. translated_title: 面向自主硅片覆盖率收敛的基于规范的适应性分类与形式化不变量排除综合
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.26815v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在硅片流片过程中，收敛最后5%-15%的代码和功能覆盖率仍然是一个主要的进度瓶颈。现有的基于LLM的覆盖率收敛环路将原始未覆盖的RTL行或分支直接输入迭代提示中，在工业子系统中由于以下原因而失败：（1）通过独立查询数千个相关漏洞导致令牌和上下文爆炸；（2）非法激励违反跨信号不变量并产生脏覆盖；（3）在结构上不可达的死代码上产生不安全的排除幻觉。 我们提出了ARGUS（自主可达性与引导统一激励），一个基于规范的、双模式的覆盖率收敛和形式化排除综合引擎。ARGUS挖掘微架构规范和SystemVerilog断言到形式化的块契约（C）中，然后运行由每模块漏洞密度阈值（tau）门控的适应性宏聚类与微手术分类：密集模块将相关漏洞折叠为
tldr: 本文提出ARGUS，一个基于规范的形式化覆盖率收敛引擎，通过挖掘规范和断言构建块契约，并采用适应性宏聚类与微手术分类策略，解决了传统LLM覆盖率收敛中的令牌爆炸、非法激励和不安全排除三大问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ARGUS, a specification-grounded formal coverage closure engine that mines specs and assertions into Block Contracts and employs adaptive Macro-Clustering vs. Micro-Surgery triage to solve token explosion, illegal stimulus, and unsafe exclusion issues in traditional LLM-based coverage closure loops.
